Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Railgun

Whether through chance or experimentation, you have learned to transmute an unknown element that cannot logically exist. As an action for 10 cursed energy, you transmute a 5 ft sphere of air or material you touch into a 5 ft cube of Aether for 1 minute. Any creature other than you that comes into contact with or hits the Aether with a melee attack within 5 ft of it takes 20d4 necrotic damage. A creature can only take this damage once per turn and it ignores immunity and resistances. The Aether has an AC of 1 and 100 hit points.
You are able to touch the Aether harmlessly and pass through it as if it were difficult terrain. You can move or reshape the Aether as an action while it is within 100 ft of you. You can move it up to 30 ft and if the Aether enters another creature’s space, it must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 20d4 necrotic damage. If you reshape the Aether, you can change its shape or split it into two smaller spheres. Touching these smaller cubes instead deals 10d4 necrotic damage.
You can only move one cube of Aether at a time no matter what size it is. While within 5 ft of Aether, you can spend half your movement to enter the Aether’s space and reappear from another Aether cube.
